requirement: v3.6.0 release candidate: prove the remote-desktop /start path borrows the shared WebRtcTransportPool by default, warms the target half over the relay ack control plane, keeps view frames off the relay, falls back only when transport=auto and names why, and never closes a shared peer on stop.

assertions.viewer_happy_path: remote-view-route starts channel=webrtc; the first pool payload is view.hello; view.hello_ack drives view.request; a 4 KiB sealed view.frame is opened locally; relay request count is 1 and relay frame count is 0.
assertions.viewer_target_order: The viewer calls pool.ensure(target) before the ack poll completes; a target that cannot answer until a peer is in the room does not deadlock the start path.
assertions.stop_shared_pool: POST /api/w2m/remote/stop sends view.stop, removes the desktop pool subscription, and does not call closePeer on the shared transport.
assertions.fallback_and_strict: ack prepared=false yields channel=relay with fallback_reason=WEBRTC_POOL_UNAVAILABLE; transport=webrtc returns 502 WEBRTC_UNAVAILABLE and never dials UDP or relay.
assertions.target_warmup: A transport=webrtc request calls prepareWebRtc(viewer_machine_id), posts one ack with ok/code, and starts no relay frame stream; a prepare failure posts ok:false; an old request without transport still streams relay frames.
assertions.relay_ack_security: POST /v1/remote/ack is refused for a non-target; GET is 403 REMOTE_ACK_FORBIDDEN for a different machine without consuming the record; the real viewer reads prepared=true once and the second read is 404; a viewer cannot post another machine's viewer_machine_id.
assertions.mailbox: remote-requests keeps transport=webrtc and viewer_machine_id, defaults old requests to relay, and expires acks.
assertions.late_registry_binding: registerDesktop mounted before the shared pool exists still borrows the process-wide registry at /start time; it never freezes to the no-pool closure.
assertions.regression: 193 tests passed, 0 failed across the 9 named suites; full-repository ESLint exited 0 with 0 errors.
